_comment: print_error texts Bambu Studio does not ship, kept from the ha-bambulab table Bambuddy used before #2728. scripts/generate_hms_catalog.py adds them only where Studio has no entry. Keys are the 8-hex print_error value.

error.03008002: First layer defects were detected by the Micro Lidar. Please check the quality of the printed model before continuing your print.
error.03008004: Filament ran out. Please load new filament.
error.03008006: The build plate marker was not detected. Please confirm the build plate is correctly positioned on the heatbed with all four corners aligned, and the marker is visible.
error.03008011: Detected build plate is not the same as the Gcode file. Please adjust slicer settings or use the correct plate.
error.0300801B: Nozzle temperature problem detected. Refer to Assistant to re-connect the hotend connector. POWER OFF the printer before this operation to avoid short circuits.
error.03008057: The rotary attachment is disconnected. Please ensure it is properly installed and the cable is securely plugged in.
error.03008058: The rotary attachment is detected. Please remove it before continuing.
error.050040A3: AMS(or AMS lite) A communication is abnormal. Please reconnect the module cable or restart the printer.

error.050040A5: The current firmware only supports AMS/AMS 2 Pro/AMS HT, with a maximum of 4 units. Please remove all AMS units before reconnecting the supported one.
error.05008048: The module on the toolhead is not calibrated. Please cancel the task to perform calibration or switch to a calibrated module.
